'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Mike Tomashewski DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Tomashewski]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Damp Toes.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Username:''' Shewski
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
